People: Luigi Capuana (author, Wikidata Q468662), died 1915. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Capuana, Luigi, 1839-1915") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Studi sulla letteratura contemporanea, Milano G. Brigola, 1880-1882, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/studisullaletter00capuuoft. The scan does not show the credit of Luigi Capuana, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
